english translation text: THIS IS THE BAZAAR OF DAMASCUS

arabic text: MAZLUM KA KUNBA, JAB SHAAM KO POHNCHA, ABID KA THA NAWHA\nLO AGAYA BAZAAR
english translation text: ABID (ZAIN UL ABIDEEN) LAMENTED, WHEN THE CARAVAN OF THE\nOPPRESSED ARRIVED IN SHAAM, WE HAVE REACHED THE BAZAAR OF SHAAM

arabic text: LO AGAYA BAZAAR\nMERI PHUPHI AMMA, ROTI HAI BEPARDA, LAKHON KA HAI MAJHMA
english translation text: MY BELOVED AUNT ZAINAB, IS CRYING WITHOUT A VEIL, THERE\nARE THOUSANDS OF ONLOOKERS, WE HAVE REACHED THE BAZAAR

arabic text: YE SOCH KE ROTA HOON, MA BEHNE KHULE SAR HAI,\nKIS TARHA SE DEKHOONGA, JO SAMNE MANZAR HAI
english translation text: I AM THINKING OF THIS AND CRYING, THAT MY MOTHERS AND SISTERS ARE BAREHEADED\nHOW CAN I EVEN BEAR TO LOOK AT THIS ATMOSTPHERE IN FRONT OF ME?

arabic text: NEZE PE HAI EK SAR, ROTA HAI JO AKSAR\nKARTA HAI JO NAWHA, LO AGAYA BAZAAR
english translation text: BUT THERE IS ONE HEAD RAISED ON A SPEAR,\nWHICH IS CONSTANTLY CRYING AND LAMENTING, WE HAVE REACHED THE BAZAAR

arabic text: BAZU HAI BANDHE MERE, MAIN KUCH NAHI KAR SAKTA,\nBOCHAAR HAI PATHAR KI, HUM SAB HAI RASAN BASTA
english translation text: MY HANDS ARE TIED, I CANT DO ANYTHING! THERE IS\nA SHOWER OF STONES, AND WE ARE TIED TOGETHER AS TARGETS

arabic text: HAI KHOON KA DARYA, JO SAR SE HAI BEHTA,\nHASTA HAI YE AADA, LO AGAYA BAZAAR
english translation text: THERE ARE RIVERS OF BLOOD FLOWING FROM OUR HEADS, AND\nTHESE MEN ARE LAUGHING AT US, WE HAVE REACHED THE BAZAAR

arabic text: HAR EK QADAM BABA, QURAN SUNATA HAI\nAUR AAG KE PATTHAR KHUD, CHEHRE PE WO KHAATE HAIN
english translation text: MY FATHER IS RECITING QURAN WITH EVERY STEP OF THIS JOURNEY, AND\nHE IS BEING HIT WITH FIRE AND STONES TO HIS OWN BLESSED FACE

arabic text: ZAHRA KA DULARA, AHMED KA NAWASA,\nHAI BARSARE NEZA, LO AAGAYA BAZAAR
english translation text: THE BELOVED OF ZAHRA (AS),\nTHE GRANDSON OF AHMED (SAW) IS RAISED UPON A SPEAR, WE HAVE REACHED THE BAZAAR

arabic text: PARDE KA MUHAFIZ AB, SAR APNA GIRAATA HAI,\nKHOON ROTA HAI WO GHAAZI, JAB BHI NAZAR AATA HAI
english translation text: THE PROTECTOR OF ZAINAB’S VEIL, IS LETTING HIS HEAD FALL TO THE\nGROUND THIS IS ABBAS, CRYING TEARS OF BLOOD WHEN HE WITNESSES THIS

arabic text: ZAINAB KA KHULA SAR, AUR SHAAM KA MANZAR\nSAR PE NAHI PARDA, LO AGAYA BAZAAR
english translation text: ZAINAB IS BAREHEADED,\nAND ALL OF SHAAM IS IN FRONT OF US SHE HAS NOT EVEN A CLOTH TO PROTECT HER HEAD, WE HAVE REACHED THE BAZAAR

arabic text: AUR SHIMR YE ABID (AS) SE, KIS FAKHRE SE KEHTA HAI,\nPARDA TERI ZAINAB KA, NEZE PE UTARA HAI
english translation text: THEN SHIMR SAYS TO ABID (AS) WITH SUCH ARROGANCE AND PRIDE,\n'I HAVE REMOVED THE VEIL OF YOUR ZAINAB, USING JUST MY SPEAR'

arabic text: QUWWAT HAI YE MERI, AHMED KI NAWASI,\nKO SHAAM ME LAYAA, LO AGAYA BAZAAR
english translation text: SHIMR SAYS,\n'THIS IS MY MIGHT AND POWER THAT I MYSELF CAN BRING THE GRANDDAUGHTER OF THE PROPHET TO THE BAZAAR OF SHAAM'
